title: Pediatric Growth Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Interpret pediatric growth using age-appropriate anthropometric standards rather than isolated raw measurements.
Escalate quickly when severe wasting, edema, or low MUAC suggests severe acute malnutrition.
Trend measurements over time so faltering growth prompts dietary, social, and medical review.

title: Developmental Milestone Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Assess developmental milestones against age-appropriate expectations across gross motor, fine motor, language, and social domains.
Escalate referral when multiple domains are delayed, regression is reported, or red-flag milestones are missed.
Document follow-up timing clearly so borderline concerns are not left unreviewed.
